run_benchmark_hadamard_transform: run the hadamard transform benchmark comparing JIT kernel, AOT kernel, and naive scipy implementations across batch sizes and dimensions
test_hadamard_transform_jit_kernel: test the JIT kernel hadamard transform function with a given tensor and scale factor
benchmark_hadamard_transform_performance: benchmark the hadamard transform performance across multiple batch sizes and dimensions using triton perf_report
register_cuda_ci_hadamard_benchmark: register the hadamard transform benchmark as a CUDA CI test with estimated time and suite configuration
run_benchmark_cli_hadamard: run the hadamard transform benchmark CLI module that prints performance data across all provider configurations
